title: SharePoint: edit, version, restore and copy site skills in Copilot in SharePoint
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing, availability controls and file-content API match the Microsoft sources checked. The documentation supports the distinction between included skill management and credit-consuming advanced work, while the remaining publishing and dedicated audit-event gaps are appropriately identified.
